note: Made by the steps in TV_PICTURES.md: the chapter is split into sections that each carry one deep meaning ("sections"), 10 picture ideas are written for each, the top two for each picture are made and the better is chosen by eye (2026-11-22). Wide pictures only (1920x1088); the "tall" names are kept for the day tall pictures are switched back on. Each scene starts at the first word of its verse. The important part of every picture sits in the upper two thirds, clear of the words. God is not pictured, and Eve, Cain, Abel, Lamech and the rest are not portrayed as biblical people: their story is shown through ordinary people of today and through the text's own images (the offerings, sin crouching at the door, the blood crying from the ground, the city, the tents, the lyre and the forge). The killing and the violence of the chapter are never shown, only what they leave behind. 16 pictures chosen from 32 trial pictures (3 of them made on a second run after the first left them out). Pictures in Genesis 3 and 5 were checked so none is repeated (the hand letting dry earth run out was not used here because Genesis 3 has it).
method: Second method, asked for by Obay on 2026-11-21: (1) split the chapter into sections that each carry one deep meaning, written as one plain sentence; (2) write 10 different picture ideas for each section; (3) judge them: which shows the deep meaning most truly, then which a watcher understands at once while hearing the words, then which is most engaging; (4) make the top two for each picture slot as real pictures ("candidates") and choose by eye. A section has one or two pictures.

sections.meaning: A first son is received with joy as a gift had with Yahweh's help, then a brother is born, and the two grow up into different work: one keeps flocks, the other works the ground.
ideas: A young mother sits up in bed at morning holding her newborn son, smiling down at him with tearful joy
A young mother at a bright window holds her newborn against her cheek, eyes closed in thanks
A father and mother lean together over their first baby in a hospital room
A tiny newborn's hand closes round his mother's finger
Two grown brothers at work on one farm, a low stone wall between them: one leads sheep across a hillside, the other turns the earth of a plowed field
Two brothers walk out from a farmhouse at dawn to where the path forks, one with a shepherd's crook toward the sheep, one with a hoe toward the field
Two small boys play on a farmhouse floor, one with toy sheep, one with a toy tractor
A shepherd's crook and a hoe lean side by side against a barn wall
A family photograph on a mantel of a mother with two little sons
A shepherd brother and a farmer brother shake hands at the gate between pasture and field

sections.meaning: Two brothers bring gifts; the one who gave the firstborn and the best is regarded, the other's face falls in anger, and he is warned that sin crouches at his door longing for him, but he must master it.
ideas: Two gifts set side by side on an outdoor table: a basket of vegetables, and a young shepherd laying down his finest firstborn lamb on a clean blanket
A young shepherd carries the finest newborn lamb of his flock up a hillside in his arms
A shepherd lays his hand on the head of the first lamb born that spring, choosing it out of the flock
A young farmer stands by his basket of vegetables at evening with his face fallen and his fists clenched, his brother with a lamb far behind
A young man sits alone on a crate in a farm shed at dusk, staring at the floor with a dark, sullen face
A young man glares sideways at his brother across a family dinner table
A black panther crouches low on the front step of a house at dusk, eyes fixed on the closed door
A man on his doorstep holds a heavy chain, and a black wolf crouches at the end of it, eyes on him
A man firmly holds a powerful straining dog on a short leash
A rider reins in a rearing horse and brings it under control

sections.meaning: Anger that was not mastered ends in a brother's death; the killer denies being his brother's guardian, the brother's blood cries out from the ground, and the ground will no longer give him its strength.
ideas: A shepherd's crook lies dropped in the tall grass of an empty field at dusk, a few sheep wandering untended
A flock of sheep waits at nightfall at a closed pasture gate, no shepherd coming
Two sets of footprints lead into a field and only one comes back
An empty chair at a family dinner table
A young man turns his back and shrugs, hands spread, in an empty field
One small patch of bright red poppies grows out of a wide bare field of dark earth
Red poppies rise out of a deep crack split open in dry earth
A farmer kneels in a dry cracked field holding up a withered plant, rows of dead crops behind him
A farmer stands in his withered plot with a watering can while his neighbour's field across the fence is lush and green
A farmer's open hand lets dry dust run through his fingers over barren ground

sections.meaning: Driven out, hidden from God's face and afraid that anyone will kill him, the guilty wanderer is still shielded by Yahweh from those who would take revenge, and he goes away to live in the land of wandering.
ideas: A young man walks alone at night along an endless empty highway, glancing back in fear at headlights far behind
A young man huddles under an overpass at night, hood up, half hiding his face
A young man walks away from a lush garden gate along a dusty road into barren land
A man sits on a bus-station bench at night with a single bag, nowhere to go
A weary young man sleeps by a small campfire in the wild while a big shepherd dog lies awake beside him on guard
A man sleeps by a campfire in a dark forest while wolves watch from the edge of the firelight and keep their distance
A homeless man sleeps on a park bench and a passer-by lays a blanket over him
A lone traveller walks a dark road inside the circle of light of a single streetlamp
A man in a hooded jacket stands at a crossroads in the desert at dusk, every road empty
A man's back as he walks into a vast empty plain toward the dawn

sections.meaning: The wanderer's family builds a city and the arts of life: a city named for a son, tents and herds, the lyre and the pipe, and tools of bronze and iron.
ideas: A father guides his small son's hand to press a handprint into the wet concrete of a new building's cornerstone, cranes and new frames behind
A father with his son on his shoulders points down at a new town being built below them
A builder lays bricks while his young son hands him the next one
A camp of round felt tents on a wide plain at evening with herds around it, a young man playing a flute and a young woman a small harp by the fire
A herdsman sits on a rise playing a wooden flute above his tents and grazing herds
Close view of hands plucking the strings of a small wooden harp
A blacksmith hammers a glowing axe head on an anvil, sparks flying, finished tools on the wall
A metalworker pours glowing molten bronze from a crucible into a mould
A long wall of family portraits going back generations
A city skyline at dusk, its lights coming on

sections.meaning: Revenge grows: Lamech boasts to his wives that he killed a man for a wound, and claims vengeance seventy-seven times over.
ideas: A hard-faced man at a kitchen table boasts, his bandaged fist clenched on the tabletop, while two women stand back uneasily
A wildfire races over dark hills, grown huge from one dropped match still burning in the foreground
A small snowball rolling down a mountainside has become an avalanche
Two neighbours' fences, each built higher than the other's, towering over a narrow alley
A man shouts proudly with his chest out in front of a cracked mirror
A row of dominoes falling, each bigger than the last
A man counts on a scorecard nailed to a wall, marks running on and on
A bandaged hand and a broken bottle on a bar counter
Two cars nose to nose in a road-rage standoff
A spark from a grinder landing in a pile of dry straw

sections.meaning: God sets another son in place of the one who was killed, and with the next generation people begin to call on the name of Yahweh.
ideas: A father and mother stand over their newborn's cradle with tender, tearful joy, a framed photograph of an older boy and a toy lamb on the shelf beside them
A father and mother kneel in prayer beside their newborn's cradle, a photograph of an older boy above them
A newborn's hand in his father's palm beside a framed photograph of an older boy
A young seedling planted where an old tree once stood
A young father kneels with his small son at the boy's bedside, both praying with folded hands
Families stand together on a hilltop at sunrise, faces and hands lifted, calling out in prayer
A grandfather, a father and a small boy bow their heads together at a family table
A father lifts his small son to ring a bell at sunrise
A mother teaches her little boy to fold his hands in prayer
A single lit window in a dark village at night, a family praying inside

scenes.principle: Eve gives birth to her first son and says she has gotten a man with Yahweh.
scenes.shows: A young mother sits up in bed at morning holding her newborn son, smiling down at him with tearful joy.
scenes.prompt: In a sunlit bedroom at morning, a young mother sits up in bed holding her newborn son wrapped in a white blanket, gazing down at him with a radiant, tearful smile of joy and wonder. Soft daylight from the window falls on the two of them.

scenes.principle: A brother, Abel, is born, and the two take different work: Abel keeps flocks and Cain works the ground.
scenes.shows: Two grown brothers at work on one farm, a low stone wall between them: one leads his sheep across a green hillside, the other turns the earth of a plowed field.
scenes.prompt: Two grown brothers in their twenties on a farm at morning, a low stone wall between them. On the left one leads a flock of white sheep across a green hillside with a wooden shepherd's crook; on the right the other turns dark brown earth with a hoe in a freshly plowed field. Both are seen clearly at work.

scenes.principle: Cain brings some of the fruit of the ground, and Abel brings the firstborn of his flock and the best of them.
scenes.shows: Two gifts set side by side on an outdoor table: a basket of vegetables, and a young shepherd laying down his finest firstborn lamb on a clean blanket.
scenes.prompt: Outdoors on a rough wooden table at morning, two gifts are set side by side: on the left a basket of vegetables from the field; on the right a young shepherd gently sets down his finest firstborn lamb, pure white, on a clean folded blanket. His hands and the lamb are the clearest part of the picture.

scenes.principle: Cain's offering is not regarded; he is very angry and his face falls.
scenes.shows: A young farmer stands by his basket of vegetables at evening, his face fallen and his fists clenched, while his brother stands far behind holding a white lamb.
scenes.prompt: A young farmer in dusty work clothes stands beside a basket of vegetables at the edge of a field at evening, his head lowered and his face fallen, jaw clenched in bitter anger, fists tight at his sides. Far behind him, soft and out of focus, a young shepherd stands holding a white lamb.

scenes.principle: If he does not do good, sin is crouching at the entrance, longing for him, but he must govern it.
scenes.shows: A black panther crouches low on the front step of a house at dusk, its eyes fixed on the closed door.
scenes.prompt: At dusk a black panther crouches low on the front step of an ordinary country house, body flattened and tense as if ready to spring, its eyes fixed on the closed wooden front door. Warm light glows in the windows beside the door.

scenes.principle: Cain kills his brother in the field, and when asked where Abel is, answers: am I my brother's guardian?
scenes.shows: A shepherd's crook lies dropped in the tall grass of an empty field at dusk, a few sheep wandering untended in the distance.
scenes.prompt: An empty grassy field at dusk under a heavy grey sky. A wooden shepherd's crook lies dropped in the tall grass in the middle of the field, and a few sheep wander untended in the distance.

scenes.principle: The voice of his brother's blood cries out from the ground, which opened its mouth to take it.
scenes.shows: One small patch of bright red poppies grows out of a wide bare field of dark earth under a grey sky.
scenes.prompt: A wide bare field of dark brown earth under an overcast sky. In the middle of it one small patch of bright red poppies grows out of the bare ground, the only colour anywhere in the scene.

scenes.principle: When Cain works the ground it will no longer give him its strength, and he will be a drifter and a wanderer.
scenes.shows: A young farmer kneels in a dry, cracked field holding up a withered plant, rows of dead crops all around him.
scenes.prompt: A young farmer kneels in a dry, cracked field under a hard pale sky, holding a withered brown plant up in his hand and looking at it in dismay. Rows of dead, dried-up crops stretch away behind him.

scenes.principle: Driven from the ground and hidden from God's face, Cain fears that anyone who finds him will kill him.
scenes.shows: A young man walks alone at night along an endless empty highway, glancing back in fear at headlights far behind him.
scenes.prompt: A young man in a hooded jacket walks alone at night along the edge of an endless empty highway through barren land, glancing back over his shoulder with fear on his face. Far behind him a pair of headlights is coming.

scenes.principle: Yahweh sets a sign for Cain so that no one who finds him will strike him down, and Cain lives in the land of wandering.
scenes.shows: A weary young man sleeps beside a small campfire in wild country at night while a big shepherd dog lies awake beside him on guard.
scenes.prompt: In wild open country at night a weary young man sleeps on the ground beside a small campfire, wrapped in his coat. Beside him a large shepherd dog lies wide awake on guard, head up and ears raised, watching the darkness for him.

scenes.principle: Cain becomes the builder of a city and names it after his son.
scenes.shows: A father guides his small son's hand to press a handprint into the wet concrete of a new building's cornerstone, cranes and new frames rising behind them.
scenes.prompt: A father guides his small son's hand as the boy presses his handprint into the wet concrete of a new building's cornerstone. Behind them the frames and cranes of a new town are rising in morning light. No church or steeple.

scenes.principle: Jabal is the father of those who live in tents among herds, and Jubal of all who play the lyre and the pipe.
scenes.shows: A camp of round felt tents on a wide plain at evening with herds grazing round it; by the fire a young man plays a flute and a young woman a small harp.
scenes.prompt: On a wide grassy plain at evening, a camp of round felt tents with herds of cattle and horses grazing around them. By a small fire in front of the tents a young man plays a wooden flute and a young woman plucks a small wooden harp.

scenes.principle: Tubal-cain forges every cutting tool of bronze and iron.
scenes.shows: A blacksmith hammers a glowing axe head on an anvil, sparks flying, finished tools hanging on the wall behind.
scenes.prompt: In a dim workshop a blacksmith in a leather apron hammers a glowing orange axe head on an anvil, bright sparks flying. Finished tools hang on the wall behind him.

scenes.principle: Lamech boasts to his two wives that he killed a man for a wound, and claims vengeance seventy-seven times over.
scenes.shows: A hard-faced man at a kitchen table boasts with his bandaged fist clenched on the tabletop, while two women stand back by the doorway watching him uneasily.
scenes.prompt: In a dim kitchen at night a hard-faced man sits at the table with his bandaged, bruised hand clenched into a fist on the tabletop, leaning forward and boasting. Two women stand back by the doorway watching him uneasily.

scenes.principle: God sets another son, Seth, in place of Abel, whom Cain killed.
scenes.shows: A father and mother stand over their newborn's cradle with tender, tearful joy; on the shelf beside them stand a framed photograph of an older boy and a small toy lamb.
scenes.prompt: In a quiet nursery at morning a father and mother stand together over a cradle, gazing at their newborn son with tender, tearful joy. On the shelf beside them stand a framed photograph of an older boy and a small wooden toy lamb.

scenes.principle: A son is born to Seth, and at that time people begin to call on the name of Yahweh.
scenes.shows: A young father kneels with his small son at the boy's bedside, both praying with folded hands.
scenes.prompt: At evening a young father kneels beside his small son at the boy's bedside, both with their hands folded and their eyes closed in prayer, a warm lamp glowing.
